tei:div.tei:p: "$ (395)༄༅// mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud spyi khyab kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga bkra shis grags pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(396)༄༅// na mo gu ru dzam+budwī pa kīrti ye/ spros pa'i mtha' bral bde stong zung 'jug dang*// gang 'dul rnam par rol ba rdo rje'i gar// cir yang sgyur mdzad bka' bzhi brgyud pa dang*// sprul pas sprul pa'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'dud// thabs grol byin rlabs lam las tshe gcig gis// rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal sar gshegs mdzad pa// bka' brgyud grub pa'i khyu dang de kun gyi// ye shes gcig bsdus khyab bdag bla mas skyongs// thun mong dngos grub thabs ches mang yang*// mchog grub zab mo 'di las gzhan med pa// mdo rgyud kun mthun gong mas phyag len tu// bstan pa'i don bzhin 'dir yang mos blos dgod/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i lam las tshe gcig gis mchog gi dngos grub don tu gnyer ba rnams kyis nyams su blang bya'i gtso bo bla ma'i rim pa yin cing*/ khyad par mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud mos gus dang byin rlabs kyi bka' babs yin pas grub thob gong ma rnams kyang bla ma'i lam las grub pa'i rgyal sar gshegs pa sha stag yin pa'i phyir/ rjes 'jug rnams kyang mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu dril ba kho na gal che bas 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i tshul la'ang rgyud dang grub chen so so'i bzhed pas phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul mang du mchis pa las 'dir tshogs gsog gtsor bton pa bla ma mchod pa'i (397)rim pa yin cing*/ 'di la'ang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyi rol mchod pa las brtsams te pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta dang a ḍha ya sogs kyi bzhed gzhung 'phags yul ba'i phyag bzhes rnam par dag pa'i lugs kyang mchis mod// skabs 'dir bod snga ma rnams kyi lugs dang mthun par bla mchod thun mong ba tsam gyi ngag 'don mdor bsdus te bkod pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la sbyor ba gnas khang gtsang zhing dag par bya/ rgyan gyi bye brag ji ltar 'byor pas spras pa'i gung du dkon mchog gi rten gsum spyi dang*/

khyad par mnyam med dwags po rin po che gtso bor gyur ba'i rdo rje 'chang nas brtsam rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bka' brgyud gser gyi phreng ba rnams kyi sku brnyan bris 'bur phyag zhabs kyi rjes sogs ji tsam 'dzom pa bkram pa'i spyan sngar mchod stegs gos bzang pos bkab ba'i dbus su rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal dris byugs pa la/ rdul tshon gyis lte ba zla gdan dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dab drug /de rgyab 'dab brgyad/ de rgyab grangs med bris pa la me tog gi tshom bu dbus su che ba gcig /de rgyab pad 'dab kyi grangs mtshungs tshom bu bkod/ rdul tshon gyis bris ma lcogs na tshom bu kho na grangs gong mtshungs bkod pas kyang rung ste mañji'i khri la bkod/ mdun du 'bul gtor dkar zlum rgyan ldan bza' bca' bzang po dang bcas (398)pa// mtha' bskor du chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams brgya rtsa sogs gang 'byor bskor bsham mam/ mang du ma 'dzom na cha gcig phreng tshar du bsham/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya/ bkra shis rdzas rtags/ rgyal srid sna bdun rnams kyang bris 'bur sogs gang 'byor bkod legs bar bkram/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba/ rol mo'i bye brag /sngon gtor gyis mtshon mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs bar bya/ tshogs mchod 'bul bar 'dod na thabs shes kyi rdzas gtso bor kyur ba'i tshogs kyi yo byad rnams 'du bya'o// cho ga'i sngon 'gro'i thog mar bdag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dho sarba dharmā ཿswa bhā ba shud+dho ྅haṃ gis sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa'i nang bu hūm̐ bh+rūṃ oṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams las sha lnga/

ba ྃmam̐ ta ྃpam̐ lam̐ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas bcu zhu zhing bskol ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngags lan gsum/ sngon 'gro mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang na'ang legs mod/ 'byung gtor thun mong tsam byed na/ dkar gtor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ yongs su gyur pa las lha'i zhal zas ro bcud sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag rnams spyan drangs par gyur/ dril bu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ da sha di klo ka pā la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ zhes spyan drangs shing bzhugs pa la gong gi sngags de'i mthar/ ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar btags pas mchod cing*/ pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdor thal kha phye ba'i phyag rgyas (399)oṃ da sha di klo ka pā la bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes pa gsum gyis phul nas/ /gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po sde brgyad sogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon nas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol la/ gang dag gsang sngags kyi cho ga thos pa dang mthong bar mi dbang ba rnams kyang gtor ma'i lhag ma 'dis tshims par gyis la rang gnas su dengs shing*/ gal te mi 'gro na rab tu 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes mgo bo 'gem par byed do/ /zhes rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa'am yi dam gang yin gyi snying po dang*/

sum+bha ni sogs brjod la bsdad/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bres/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba kun nas brtan par gyur// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams ye shes kyi rang bzhin mchod pa'i rnam pa/ zag med bde chen gyi rgyu bla na med pas mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pād+yaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da bar sbyar/ rol mo byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi tā nā da (400)sam+ba bha wi ta/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni/ san+to ṣi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ mchod pa gzhan nam mkha' gang bar spel la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi dang bcas pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/lan gsum la sogs pas skyabs su 'gro/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i bya ba la 'jug par bgyi'o/ lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thog mar mchod pa'i rten gsal gdab pa ni/ sa phyogs thams cad dag pa'i zhing khams kyi// ngo mtshar bkod pa bsam yas phun sum tshogs// phyogs mtshams kun tu mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs// de dbus thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*// yangs shing rgya che mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs// byang chos so bdun rnam thar sgo mtha' yas// rgyal ba'i yon tan kun tshang nang gi char// pad+ma 'dab drug de rgyab 'dab ma brgyad// de rgyab pad 'dab grangs med zlum por 'khyil// pad lter seng khri pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dbyer med sgam po 'dzam gling grags pa'i zhabs// dkar gsal zhi 'dzum mnyam bzhag nor bu bsnams// sgom zhu (401)chos gos rnam gsum brjid par klubs// zhabs gnyis rdor skyil thugs rje tshad med pa'i// ye shes gzi byin 'bar bzhin lham mer bzhugs// dbu gtsug rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje dang*// sku yi g.yas su ras chung rdo rje grags// g.yon tu ston pa bo dhi rā dza bcas// de yi dbu gtsug mar pa lo tsā yi// g.yas g.yon mdun tu mes rngog mtshur gsum bzhugs// de yi dbu gtsug paṇa chen nā ro pa// g.yas g.yon mai tri pa dang ti phu pa// de yi dbu gtsug grub chen te lo pa// g.yas g.yon sa ra ha dang sha ba ri// de yi dbu gtsug drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// mthing mdog rdor dril ye shes mkha' 'gror 'khyud// mtha' bskor bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// kun kyang rang rang chas ldan gzi byin 'bar// gtso bo'i mdun du dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen// phyag rgya mnyam bzhag zhwa nag gser mdangs gsol// g.yas su 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal// sa gnon mnyam bzhag sgom zhu brjid chags gsol// g.yon tu sgom pa tshul khrims snying po'i zhabs// phyag gnyis chos 'chad mnyam bzhag nor bus mtshan// rgyab g.yas 'ba' ram dar ma dbang phyug dang*// rgyab g.yon 'gro mgon tshal pa brtson 'grus grags// sa gnon phyag rgya rang rtags sgom zhu gsol// de rgyab pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes pa'i steng*// mdun du mnyam med 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// shar lhor dpal ldan thang pa bkra shis dpal// lho ru rgyal tsha kun dga' khu dbon zung*// lho nub grub chen gling dang rgya ras zhabs// nub tu smar ba shes rab ye shes pa// nub byang 'gro mgon yel pa ye shes brtsegs// byang du ye shes seng ge g.ya' bzang pa// byang shar gyer sgom chos kyi seng ge rnams// rab byung cha lugs rang rtags sgom (402)zhwa gsol// sa gnon mnyam bzhag chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad// skyil krung bde stong ye shes gzi ldan bzhugs// de rgyab 'dab mar bka' brgyud che bzhi dang*// chung brgyad grub thob gser gyi phreng ba'i tshogs// rang byung rnal 'byor nges med spyod pa'i chas// kun kyang sku la ye shes gzi brjid 'bar// gsung dbyangs gsang sngags rdo rje'i rang sgra sgrogs// thugs dgongs ting 'dzin sgo brgyar 'jug cing ldangs// yon tan phrin las gang la der mthun ston// phyogs mtshams rgya bod mkhas grub yi dam lha// sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// mdun tu chos skyong dam can bka' sdod tshogs// 'ja' zer thig le me dpung dbus su bzhugs// rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs su gdod nas grub// thugs mchog ye shes rol pa'i 'od zer gyis// chos kyi dbyings dang dag pa'i zhing rnams nas// bka' brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas// mdun mkhar skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur/

/ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ/ khyab bdag dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid// gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin// gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// chu zla bzhin tu gar dmigs der snang ba// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis dad pas deng 'dir gsol 'debs na// dmigs med snying rje'i dbang gis 'dir gsal mdzod// 'phags bod bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang chub sems// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas// dad ldan mchod pa'i zhing du spyan 'dren na// dmigs med thugs rje chen pos brtser dgongs la// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs chen pos gshegs su gsol/ shrī (403)mān gu ru de ba bud+dha bo nghi sa twa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pā ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ oṃ pra ba ra sat+ka ra ār+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ gdod nas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med kyang*// gnyis rtog blo yi 'ching ba dral slad du// bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor pa dang gnyis med du// bzhugs nas mos pa'i bu la dgyes dgongs mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang dbyer med du bzhugs par mos// de nas bsags sbyong spel ba'i rim pa la/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba'i rim pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs ri dwags skrag mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang*// rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen rab dkyil 'khor rgyas// mdzad pa'i 'od stong gdul bya'i gling la phog

/rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun nas gsal mdzad (404)pa'i// bka' brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang dang blo gros rin chen zhabs// sa ra ha dang dpal ldan 'phags pa klu// sha ba ri pa mnga' bdag mai tri sogs// phyag chen brgyud pa rnams la= /so so'i bka' babs rnam bzhi'i brgyud par bcas// kun 'dus grub pa'i dbang phyug te lo pa// dz+nyā na sid+dhi dri med bshes gnyen sogs// chos drug brgyud pa rnams la= /dgyes mdzad mar ston chos kyi blo gros zhabs// mes rngog mtshur gsum thugs kyi sras mchog bzhi= /las can slob ma mchog bzhi gtsor gyur pa'i// mar pa bka' brgyud rnams la= /bzhad pa rdo rje mkha' spyod gshegs pa bdun// ras pa mched brgyad nye ba'i sras chen brgyad// 'dul ba'i mchog gsum ston pa drug la sogs// mi la'i bka' brgyud rnams la= /mnyam med dwags po thugs sras grub mchog bzhi// nye ba'i sras bzhi yongs su grags pa bzhi// nye gnas bzhi dang 'phags pa gnyis la sogs// dwags po bka' brgyud rnams la= /tshul khrims snying po sgom chung 'dul 'dzin pa// gling pa rnam gnyis spyan snga lha lung pa// bkra shis rnam rgyal nor bu rgyan pa sogs// gdan sa bka' brgyud rnams la= /dpal ldan karma pa dang gar gyi dbang*// si tu rgyal tshab dpa' bo rim byon dang*// rma se rtogs ldan karma chags med sogs// kaṃ tshang bka' brgyud rnams la= /'gro mgon rdor rgyal spyan snga rim byon dang*// nyag ras se bo grub thob spar phu ba// sangs rgyas zhig chen chos sku'i mtshan can sogs// phag gru bka' brgyud rnams la= /dar ma dbang phyug brgyud 'dzin sras mchog lnga// ti shi sher seng ras pa dkar po dang*// lus med rdo rje gzhon nu 'byung gnas sogs// 'ba' ram bka' (405)brgyud rnams la= /yin nges rnam bzhi 'gro mgon skye med zhang*// shākya ye shes sangs rgyas 'bum 'od mtshan bzhi// dar ma gzhon nu gtsang sgom lce sgom sogs// tshal pa bka' brgyud rnams la=

/'jig rten gsum mgon dpal chen rnam pa bdun// rang mnyam bcu gsum grub chen gnyon mgar chos// rin chen rnam gnyis gdan rab rim byon pa'i// 'bri gung bka' brgyud rnams la= /thang pa bkra shis dpal ba rang mnyam brgyad// thugs kyi sras bzhi nye ba'i sras bco brgyad// rtogs pa mchog gyur gnyis stong brgyad brgya sogs// stag lung bka' brgyud rnams pa= /rgyal tshab rin mgon kun ldan ras pa che// byams pa dpal ba ma gcig re ma dang*// lce sgom zhig po bu ston chen po sogs// khro phu bka' brgyud rnams la= /gling ras rgya ras seng ge'i mtshan can dgu// lo rgod rnam gnyis yang dgon 'ba' ra ba// stod smad bar gsum phyogs mtha' kun khyab pa'i// 'brug pa bka' brgyud rnams la= /smar pa sher ye yang dgong spyan snga ba// dbu rtse rin gling 'od zer bla ma dang*// shing mgo rin chen rgyal mtshan rnam gsum sogs// smar tshang bka' brgyud rnams la= /sangs rgyas yel pa rtse mo 'od zer dpal// 'od gsal ba dang yang dgon blo gros rgyal// rgo na rin chen dgon sar ba la sogs// yel pa bka' brgyud rnams la= /za ra skal ldan ye shes seng ge'i zhabs// gnubs ston 'dul 'dzin chos kyi smon lam pa// rin chen jo sras rtogs ldan bu bzhi sogs// g.ya' bzang bka' brgyud rnams la= /gyer sgom chos seng stong smad rtogs ldan drug /rin chen snying po brag 'bur ri pa sogs// gang nas slob brgyud rim par byon pa yi// shugs (406)gseb bka' brgyud rnams la= /grub brgya'i spyi mes mar mi dwags gsum nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa yi// tshig gi brgyud pa don gyi brgyud pa dang*// brda dang byin rlabs man ngag brgyud pa yi// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la= /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rang sems chos sku mngon gsum ston mdzad pa// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la=

/phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ma lus dang*// byang chub sems dang rgyal sras ma lus tshogs// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi// bla med 'phags pa'i tshogs la= /bya spyod rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bla med kyi// yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus dang*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma la// rab tu gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo//

gnyis pa mchod pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las// dang po spyi khyab mchod pa'i man+ḍal lag tu thogs/ yig brgya brjod bzhin tu rdul phyis// dri bzang gi chus brlan/ 'bru la sogs pa'i cham bu phyag len ltar bkod cing*/ /oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug mu khyud kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab// shar lus 'phags po// lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ shar du lus dang lus 'phags// lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro// byang du sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo// dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che// btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che// glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che// gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ (407)phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa mngon par bkod de/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog

/zhes grangs ce nus 'bul/ de nas rje mar pa'i gsung*/ rang bzhin skye med kyi man+ḍal la// snang ba sna tshogs kyi me tog bkod// bla ma'i sku la mchod pa 'bul// bdag gi lus la byin gyis rlobs// nam mkha' rnam dag gi man+ḍal// 'gags med rten 'brel gyi me tog bkod// bla ma'i gsung lam chod pa 'bul// bdag gi dag la byin gyis rlobs// rang sems bde chen gyis man+ḍal la// rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi me tog bkod// bla ma'i thugs la mchod pa 'bul// dag gi yid la byin gyis rlobs// rin chen sa gzhi'i man+ḍal la// ri rab gling bzhi'i me tog bkod// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'bul// dag gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis rlobs/ zhing khams mtha' yas rab 'byams na/ 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed pa yi// yon (408)chab me tog bdug spos dang*// sgron me byug mchog zhal zas sogs// ji snyed legs par grub pa rnams// dam pa rje la mchod par 'bul// bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi// gdugs dang bla res dar dpyangs dang*/ blo yis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs// dam pa rje la mchod par 'bul// rtogs pa 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes dang*/ ras chung pa'i gsung las byung ba/ /dbang mchog bzhi yi maṇ+ḍal la// dga' bzhi nyams myong gi chag chag btab// bla ma brgyud pa'i sku la 'bul// lus kyi sgrib par dag gyur cig /brgyud sde bzhi yi maṇ+ḍal la// shes rab rnon pa'i chag chag btab// the tshom med pa'i me tog bkod// bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung la 'bul// ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /lus ngag yid gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal la// sdom pa gsum gyi chag chag btab// dang ba skyon med kyi me tog bkod// bla ma brgyud pa'i thugs la 'bul// sems kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /dran pa ye shes kyi maṇ+ḍal la// skye ba med pa'i chag chag btab// blo las 'das pa'i me tog bkod// dngos kyi bla ma'i thugs la 'bul// myur du skye med don rtog shog

/'khor 'das dbyer med kyi maṇ+ḍal la// ro snyoms gsum gyi chag chag btab// dgag sgrub med pa'i me tog bkod// dngos kyi bla ma'i gsung la 'bul// skye med myur du rtogs par shog /smon lam snying rje'i maṇ+ḍal la/ gzugs sku gnyis kyi chag chag btab// gzhan don mthar phyin me tog bkod// dngos kyi bla ma'i sku la 'bul// gzhan don myur du 'grub par shog /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma la// lus (409)lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa yi// dge bas bdag sogs sems can kun// 'od gsal ngang la gnas par shog /ces pa rnams dang*/ /sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes la// bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ces 'bul zhing 'dod don gsol/ bye brag tu phyi mchod dngos 'byor yid sprul ni/ /chu gtsang yid 'ong 'o ma dang 'dres pa'i// dri ma med pa'i mchod yon rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// bzhes nas dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin stsol/ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi swa twa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha swā hā// chu gtsang dri med me tog dang bcas pa'i// rab dwangs yid 'ong zhabs bsil rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor= /bzhes nas dngos grub= /sngags mgo mjug sngar ltar la/ pāt+yi pad+ma u tra la dang ku mu da// puṇ+ḍā ri ka la sogs me tog tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor= /bzhes nas dngos grub= /puṣ+pe= /a ga ru dang du ruṣ+ka la sogs// spos kyi bye brag rnam pa du ma'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor= /bzhes nas dngos grub= /dhū pe= /til mar zhun mar sgron me la sogs dang*// nor bu'i 'od sogs snang gsal du ma'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor=

/bzhes nas dngos grub= /ā lo ke= /ga bur tsan+dan gu rgum la sogs dang*// sbyar dang gyur pa'i dri mchog du ma'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor= /bzhes nas dngos grub= gan+dhe= /'bras chan dag dang gtsang ma'i bshos sogs dang*// bza' btung bye brag sna tshogs dpag med tshogs// bla ma dkyil (410)'khor= /bzhes nas dngos grub// nai wi d+ya= /pi waṃ gling bu rnga dang rdza rnga dang*// ting shag sil snyan pheb rdob rol mo'i tshogs// bla ma dkyil 'khor= /bzhes nas dngos grub= /shab+da= /sogs kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod 'bul// 'dod yon lnga ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams thams cad na// gzugs mchog rgyal ba'i spyan la mdzes pa kun// rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su rnam sprul nas// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul bar bgyi/ gu ru de wa bud+dha bo dhi sa twa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra ru pa pra tīts+tsha swā hā// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= /sgra mchog rgyal ba'i snyan la bde ba kun// rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su= /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha= sngags thogs mtha' sngar ltar la/ shab+da= /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= /ri mchog rgyal ba'i shangs la zhim pa kun// rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs su= /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha= gan+dhe= /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= /ro mchog rgyal ba'i ljags la mngar ba kun// rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su= /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha= /ra sa= /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten= /reg mchog rgyal ba'i sku la 'jam pa kun// rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su= /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha= spar+she/= /rgyal srid bdun ni/ /gser gyi 'khor lo nor bu rin po che// yid 'ong btsun mo blo ldan blon po dang*// theg chen glang po cang shes rta yi mchog /dmag dpon rin chen bdun yang dbul bar bgyi/ sngags sngar ltar dang*/ sap+ta rat+na= /bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ /rin chen gdugs bzang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u// bum pa bzang po pad+ma gser gyi nya// 'khor lo dung dkar mtshan mchog las grub pa'i// bkra shis rtags brgyad dag kyang dbul bar bgyi/

aṣ+ṭa maṅga la tsi hā= bkra shis rdzas brgyad na/ /dri med me long li khri dung dkar po/ (411)dūrba bilpa gi waṃ bcud ldan zho// yungs dkar dang bcas rgyal bas byin brlabs pa'i// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag kyang dbul bar bgyi// āṣ+ṭa maṅga la dra bya/ nye ba'i rin chen bdun ni/ /ral gri lpags pa skyed tshal khang khyim dang*// gzim cha gos dang mchil l+h+wam rin po che// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis rlabs tu gsol// u pa rat+na= lus longs spyod 'bul ba ni/ /lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa bar bcas// rang gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i go sa na// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin dang bde chen rol// zag med bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir mchod/ nang mchod ni/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐// dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur ba'i// bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa bzhes// rdo rje 'chang chen blo gros rin chen zhabs// sa ra ha sa klu sgrub sha ba ri// mnga' bdag mai tri mar pa lo tsā sogs// phyag chen brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐// rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i grub thob pho mo'i tshogs// tai lo nā ro mar pa mi la sogs// chos drug brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐// mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud che bzhi dang*// zung bzhi ya brgyad de las gyes pa yi// brgyud 'dzin grub thob skyes chen dus gsum du// gshegs shing bzhugs pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐// rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha rnams dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// chos skyong srung ma dpal mgon dam tshig can// dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ (412) gsang mchod ni/ /dga' mchog khyad dga' lhan skyes nyams 'gyur las// pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga ma// sgeg mo bzhed ma glu dang gar mkhan ma// me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma// gzugs ro reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje ma/

yid 'phrog 'jo sgeg ldan pa'i lang tsho can// nam mkha' gang bas bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mchod/ oṃ badz+ra bī ṇi āḥhūm̐/ sngags thog mtha' 'gres te/ baṃ she/ mṛ daṃ ge*/ mu ra dze/ hā se/ lā se/ gī tī/ nṛ ti/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ rū pa badz+ri/ ra sa badz+rī/ spar+she badz+rī/ dharma dhā tu badz+rī/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched gzung 'dzin dang*// btag dpyad yod med bden rdzun mtha' spangs pa// chos pa dag med pa dmigs med mnyam pa nyid// spros bral stong nyid chen po'i mchod pa 'bul/ /de ltar mchod pa'i tshig phreng rgyas pa de rnams ma lcogs na phyag 'tshal ba'i 'phros su 'dir 'jug /de dag lcogs na'ang sku la lta ba sogs slar mchod pa thams cad bsdus ste 'bul ba dang yan lag lhag ma rnams rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa brgyad pa'i gsung las byung ba 'di ltar bya ste/ bdag sogs sems can mgon med rten 'brel las// dad pa dam tshig bslu ba med pa yis// mig dang yid la mngon sum nyid du shar// bsam brjod yid las 'das pa'i dag las thob// mi bzod sku la lta ba'i mchod pa 'bul// lus kyis phyag 'tshal ngag gis bstod par bgyi// khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis yid phyag 'tshal// mthong na zag med bde ba skyed byed cing*/ /gang gi yi ger byang chub 'bras stsol ba'i/ nam mkha' khyab pa'i me tog ci yang 'bul// gang gis chor na sgrib gsum zhi nus la// legs par bdugs na dam chos ngad ldang ba'i// spos bzang sprin gyis nam mkha' rgyas par 'gegs// mi shes mun pa'i tshogs (413)rnams 'bros byed cing*// yang dag snang ba'i 'od zer 'byung gnas gcig /mchog gi sgron me 'bar mtshams ma gyur cig /mi bsrun me lce'i rnam 'gyur du ba'i zil// byams pa chen po'i dri dang chab kyi rgyun/ gcig tu 'dres te nam mkha'i mtha' la klas// bkres shing phongs ba rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i mchog

/'chi med rtag pa'i zhal zas dri ro can// mtshungs med kha dog can des zhing kun khyab// gang nas mya ngan ma lus mchis pa dag /yid 'ong sgra snyan ngag gis 'phrog byed pa'i// sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra 'dis nam mkha' sprug /kun rtog tsha zer ma lus 'gog byed pa'i// mchog gi grib bsil lta na sdug pa la// lda ldi drwa ba drwa phyed g.yer khar bcas// ba dan phur ma'i bye brag mi dman pas// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi mkha' la mngon par gar// bdud sde'i dpung tshogs dpa' ba'i gad mo rnams// nam mkha'i phyi rol la yang mi gnas phyir// rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan mas dge bar gyur// yid bzhin snying po sbyin pa'i nor bu mchog /dgos 'dod ma lus stsol bas mdzes par bgyi// rims nad ma lus gso ba'i sman chen dang*// bag yod tshul bzang gdung med na bza' ni// zad med nam mkha'i bla ma dkyil 'khor gyur// 'phags rnams dgyes pa'i bkra shis mtshan ma dang*// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub 'bebs pa'i rdzas// lus can kun la dgos 'dod nyer mkho'i gzhi// rmad byung grags pa'i dri bsung can 'di 'bul// bsam mi khyab pa'i bde gshegs pho brang mchog /gzhal yas rnam dag nor bu'i sa gzhi la// rin chen rin thang med pa'i mig mang ris// rgol ba mtha' dag 'jig pa seng (414)ge'i khri// bcos bu min pa'i dar zab rnam par klubs// ye shes dri med 'dren pa'i zhing khams mchog /sa chu me rlung mkha' snang rnam dag pa// dkyil 'khor mu mtha' med pa rab tu 'byams// mdor na bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can gyis// dge rtsa bgyis dang bgyid stsal bgyid pa la// rjes su yi rang tshogs gnyis dge rtsa 'bul// phyogs bcu'i zhing na bde gshegs ji snyed kyi// dge 'bras gang mchis de yang mchod par 'bul// rmad byung mchod pa'i yul snang de dag kun// rnam kun mchog tu mi 'gyur stong nyid dang*// 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ros btab nas// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnam dag pa// rdo rje bde ba dam pa'i ngo bo 'bul// mdor na sku la phrin las phyag rgya 'bul// gsung la dam tshig ye shes phyag rgya 'bul// thugs la bdud 'joms phyag rgya chen po 'bul// mchod yul mchod byed mchod bya thams cad pa// rang gi ngo bos ma grub sgyu ma tsam// sgyu ma tsam du mchod pa phul ba'i dges// sgyu ma tsam du sems can thams cad kyis// bde skyid zad med 'byung 'di'ang 'bul bar bgyi/

gsum pa sdig pa bshags pas spyi bshags ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs ba 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*// gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*// de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa las 'gal ba dang*// byang chub sems pa'i (415)bslab pa las 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig las 'gal ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ pha dang ma la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyid pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma dad cing ma gus pa bgyis pa dang*/ gsung rab kyi glud zos pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang*/ sems can la gnod pa bgyis pa la sogs mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do/ slan chad kyang gcod cing bsdam par bgyi'o// mthol zhing bshags na bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur la// ma mthol zhing ma bshags na de de ltar du mi 'gyur ba lags so// bde gshegs dgyes pa'i lta spyod rnam dag gi /mchod pa gang des mkha' mnyam sems can gyis// thog med dus nas bsags pa'i rang bzhin dang*// bcas pa las gyur kha na ma tho'i sdig /gang bsags de dag nyes gyur nyes pa las// nyes par mthong nas mi bzod 'gyod pa skyes// de phyir sgo gsum nongs pa mthol zhing bshags// phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid na// sngar byas las ngan 'bras myong ma gyur cig

/sdug bsngal sna tshogs bskyed pa'i sdig rgyun ni/ drungs nas 'byin byed byang chub spyod mchog gi /gnyen po (416)kun du spyod pa dge ba'i stobs// mkha' mnyam sems can rgyud la rdzogs gyur cig /gang la bshags dang gang gis bshags pa dang*// bshags pa thams cad rang bzhin ma grub pas// rten 'brel tsam du bshags pa'i chos nyid kyis// rang gzhan sdug bsngal gnas par ma gyur cig

/zhes bshags pa bya/ bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba ni/ /mchog gi bla ma dkon mchog rnam pa gsum// yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi ngo bor shar// de la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs// bka' sdod dam can tshogs bcas mu mtha' med// thugs rje che mgon rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// mkhyen rab nus pa phrin las zab mo la// bsam gyis mi khyab mos pas rjes yi rang*// de bzhin nyan thos rang sangs rgyas pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i chen po tshangs pa la sogs kyis// zag bcas zag med dge la rjes yi rang*// lhag par snyigs mar spyod cing mi bsrun du// rang bzhin dge zhing pha ma rgan rabs la// srid zhur brtson shing dkon mchog mchod pa dang*// 'dod chung chog shes dben la dga' ba yis// rang gi nyes nyes pa par bzung ba na// bag yod dran shes 'dzin la rjes yi rang*// ji srid mngon 'tshang ma rgyas de srid du// 'chal tshul rgyang bsrings skyes bu chen po yi// spyod pas bzod la rtag par rjes yi rang*/ /lnga pa chos 'khor bskul ba ni/ gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// zhing khams ngan pa chos snod ma gyur bar// 'gro blo rnyog par thub dbang gzugs 'char tshe// bdag gis ma dag gdul bya'i khams sbyangs nas// rnam dag mngon rtogs bskyed par smin byas te// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de sras slob mar bcas// sna tshogs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ (417)gang gis rnam par dkar ba'i 'khor lo yis// srid zhir ltung ba'i mtha' gnyis bcad du gsol// gang la rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dbang thob kyi// sems dpa' che yi mthu dang nus pa las// so so'i skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*// rten med nam mkha' la sogs 'byung ba las// rnam par 'ong ba'i chos kyi sgra rnams kyang*// thar 'dod skye dgu'i yid bzhin 'bab gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs la chos 'khor rtag tu gnas// mi gsung bzhugs pa gdul bya'i mtshan 'dzin yin// mtshan ma gdod nas ma grub brjod pa bral// brjod med 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo'i rgyu/

drug pa mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bsam brjod bral ba'i ye shes mnga' brnyes nas// gang la gang 'tshams sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// sems can mtha' yas khams dang dbang po'i tshogs// ji srid sbyang ba'i bya ba ma rdzogs par// gdul bya dus las mi yol phrin las kyis// mya ngan 'da' tshul mi ston bzhugs su gsol// khyad par dam chos spang zhing dkon mchog la// 'khon du 'dzin pa'i 'gro ba long ba kun// slar yang phrin las nus pas mi 'dul ba// mi srid phyir na mgon med skyabs med kyi// mgon khyod rtag tu skyabs su bzhugs par gsol// gzhan yang sems can kun la phan bde'i gter// gang na stsol nus skye dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// sna tshogs gzugs kyis skye dgu srung mdzad pa// snying rje'i dbang phyug de dag der bzhugs shig /'gro 'ong gshegs bzhugs mi mnga'i rgyal ba la// skye 'gag sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i byis blo yang*// gdod nas skye 'gag gnas gsum ga la yod// skye med don la rtag tu 'tsho gyur cig /bdun pa bsngo ba ni/ (418)bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kun// chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi dge rtsar bcas// dus gsum srid pa'i legs spyad ji snyed kun// ma rgan sems can mgon med gtol bral rnams// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nyid// da lta nyid du thob phyir bsngo bar bgyi// mdor na bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang*// byang chub chen por spyod pa'i smon lam dag /bdag sogs mkha' mnyam kun gyis bzung byas te// smon lam yongs su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /spyir phyag chen dang chos drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ bye brag mar mi dwags gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' brgyud bla ma so so'i gsol 'debs gang shes rnams ji tsam nus par bya// 'dir mdor bsdus spyi tsam du gong smos phyag 'tshal gyi tshig

/shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen rab dkyil 'khor rgyas/ sogs nas/ /bka' brgyud rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes phyag 'tshal rnams gsol 'debs su bsgyur la/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'chi ba snying nas gzir bar byin gyis rlobs// zhen pa gting nas log par byin gyis rlobs// cis kyang dgos med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// mi rtag nges shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rang sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul pa rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs// snang srid chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// snang ba bden 'dzin med par byin gyis rlobs// yul la ched 'dzin med par= /dgra la sdang ba med par= /gnyen la zhen pa med par= /nor la bsags blo med par= /tshe la rtag 'dzin med par= /'khor la bden 'dzin med par= /(419)don la yengs ba med par byin gyis rlobs// nyams la mtho dman med par= /sems la gsal 'grib med par= /rang la ngar 'dzin med par= /gang la'ang 'ching ba med par= /cir snang chos skur 'char bar= /rang sems ngo bo rtogs par byin= /sgom med yengs su med par= /gcer mthong rang ngo shes par= /gtum mo sgyu lus 'byongs par= /rmi lam 'od gsal zin par= /bar do 'pho ba 'byongs par= /tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'grub par= /rtag tu bla mas skyob par= /gegs skyon lam du 'gyur bar= /nyon mongs rang sar grol bar= /bde stong dbyer med rtogs par= /blo chos su 'gro bar= /chos lam du longs par= /lam 'khrul pa sel bar= /'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar= /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol bar= /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin par byin= /rten 'brel thabs la mkhas par byin gyis rlobs// 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes dang*/

/rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa// dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen karma pa// che bzhi chung brgyad brgyud pa 'dzin rnams dang*// 'bri stag tshal gsum dpal ldan 'brug pa sogs// zab lam phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// mnyam med 'gro mgon dwags po bka' brgyud la// gsol ba 'debs so bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs/ zhen log sgom gyi rkang par gsungs pa bzhin// zas nor kun la chags zhen med pa dang*// tshe 'di'i gdos thag chod pa'i sgom chen la// rnyed bkur zhen pa med par byin gyis rlobs// mos gus sgom gyi 'go bor gsungs (420)pa bzhin// man ngag gter sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma la// rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgom chen la// bcos min mos gus skye bar byin gyis rlobs// yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhir gsungs pa bzhin// gang shar rtog pa'i ngo bo so ma de// ma bcos de kar 'jog pa'i sgom chen la// bsgom bya blo dang bral bar byin gyis rlobs// rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur gsungs pa bzhin// ci yang ma yin cir yang 'char ba la// ma 'gags rol par 'char ba'i sgom chen la// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// skye ba kun tu sogs// zhes mkhas grub chen po ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can dang*/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mthar thug he ru ka /rgyud la bde chen skyod mdzad rnal 'byor ma// ye shes sprul bsgyur ston mdzad te lo pa// mi 'jigs spyod pa'i dbang po nā ro pa// 'dod yon lam du 'dzin pa lho pa'i zhabs// tshe gcig zung 'jug grub pa mi la rje// gsang ba bde bas grub pa ras chung pa// gsang ba bde bar smin pa lhan skyes sgron// snang ba dbang du 'dus pa'i sgam po pa// rdzu 'phrul phyag rgya grub pa sgom tshul zhabs// rlung sems rang dbang thob pa'i mtshur phu pa// ye shes phyag rgya'i mchog grub 'ba' bram pa// thugs rje drag por khros pa skye med zhang*// bde chen lhan cig skyes pa phag gru pa// rten 'brel mos gus mthar phyin 'bri stag gnyis// rnal 'byor chen po'i dgongs grol rje btsun gling*// sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zhabs// rdo rje 'chang dbang ban sgar 'jam dpal bzang*// spyan ras gzigs dngos dpal ldan karma pa// rang byung kun mkhyen khams gsum chos kyi rje// grub thob rtsod bral sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i zhabs// (421)rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod rdo rje sogs// bka' babs mos gus brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// mnyes pa gsum gyis mchod pa'i slob ma la// rjes su zung shig ma g.yel dus la bab// rang rgyud nyes pas mos gus ma bsgribs par// log pa'i mthong tshul gnas lugs bla ma la// mthol zhing bshags na dam tshig sdom pa kun// dpal ldan bla ma'i ye shes bdag la skongs// snying rje mi bzod thugs dam dgongs pa bskul// sku gnyis mngon du gyur nas sems can don// 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i thugs rje can// sku drin 'khor thabs med pa'i nges shes skyes// bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su kho thag chod// gcig chog gcig thub bla mas byin gyis rlobs/

/zhes rgyal dbang brgyad pas mdzad pa'i mos gus chen po'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ gtso bor bka' brgyud rin po che spyi'i gsung rgyun ma nam bzhi skor gyi gsol 'debs grangs ci nus su bsags/ tshogs mchod 'bul bar 'dod na skabs 'dir bya ste/ tshogs rdzas rnams gong gsal bdud rtsi lhar byin rlabs/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li// mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab ba 'di sngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ lan gsum/ byin 'bebs pa ni/ gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i gsang ba nas// dpal rdo rje 'chang chen gnas 'dir byon// gnas gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa nas// yum ye shes mkha' (422)'gro gnas 'dir byon// gnas chos 'byung thar pa'i grong khyer nas// bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i bla ma gnas 'dir byon// gnas dag pa bde stong mkha' spyod nas// mda' bsnun klu sgrub yab sras 'dir byon cig /gnas 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug te lo= /yul dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// dpa' bo chen po nā ro= /ri me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas// mnga' bdag me tri gup+ta= /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// rje lho brag chen po= /thang stong ri yi rtse mo nas// rje ras pa che chung = /shar dwags lha dpal gyi sgam po nas// rje lha rje khu dbon= /mtshur mdo bo lung gi dben gnas nas// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa= /dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod nas// 'gro mgon rdo rje rgyal po=

/gnas 'ba' brom rin chen sgrungs pa nas// rje dar ma dbang phyug= /tshal gung thang bde chen pho brang nas// zhang brtson 'grus grags pa= /gnas lung bstan so so'i dben pa nas// ya bzhi zung brgyad kyi grub thob= /gang 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas// drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma gnas 'dir byon// e baṃ zung 'jug gzhal yas nas// bcom ldan dkyil 'khor lha tshogs= /gnas yul dur khrod zhing rnams nas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs= /bdud 'dul phrin las pho brang nas// dpal ma mgon lcam dral gnas 'dir byon/ ces brjod cing rol mo bya/ /khyod dkon mchog kun 'dus yin pa la// dad mos gus gdung bas gsol btab pas// lar byin rlabs dngos grub char du 'bebs// de babs pas snang srid bdud rtsir gyur// bdud (423)rtsi des 'gro drug gi sems can tshims// 'khrul snang gi bden 'dzin rang sar dag /zag med kyi bde ba nang nas shar// ting 'dzin gyi lus stobs khong nas rgyas// mos gus gdung shugs snying nas 'bar// de bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// don chos nyid ngang du mchod pa 'bul// phyi gnas khang 'di la byin gyis rlobs// nang tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob// nged 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor thams cad la// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ de nas tshogs phud rim bzhin spros la gtor ma gsos nas/ yang nang mchod ltar byin rlabs byas la gtor bsngos ni/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ pad skor rdor thal kha bye bas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra l+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ lan gsum/ na mo rat+na gu ru e daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ grub chen sa ra ha pa// dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub// rje btsun sha ba ri pa// mnga' bdag mai tri pa chen po la sogs pa phyag chen brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen/ yum mchog ye shes mkha' 'gro/ tai lo shes rab bzang po/ nā ro dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje la sogs pa chos drug brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du sogs/ mnyam med 'dzam gling grags pa/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa/ 'ba' zom dar ma dbang phyug /skye med zhang tshal pa/ 'bri stag khro gling smar yel g.yam shug gi bka' brgyud bla ma rim par byon pa rnams kyi zhal du= bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo/ dgyes (424)mdzad he ru ka dpal/ yum mchog rdo rje bdag med ma la sogs pa yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi zhal du= dpal ldan ma hā kā la/ yum mchog 'dod khams dbang phyug gtso bor gyur pa'i ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten pa'i chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhal du= dam rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pa phul phul ba'i mthu la brten nas bdag cag rnams kyi rgyud la ye shes chen pos byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub myur ba nyid du stsal zhing phrin las rnam pa bzhi thog pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes tshogs phud phul/ phyogs skyong sogs 'jig rten pa rnams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs kyis bsngos la/ phrin las bcol/ bar pa brda' dang brda'i 'bul len bcas nang gi tshogs 'khor dang ldan pas rol// lhag ma bdud rtsis bran la/ a kā ros byin rlabs/ thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du phud lhag bshal chu'i gtor ma rgya cher 'phro zhing zad med cir yang 'char bar gyur/ sngon tshe dpal chen po'i spyan sngar 'dud cing phrin las sgrub par khas blangs pa'i las kyi mkha' 'gro/

'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ sha za mkha' 'gro pho nya'i tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// tshims zhing dgyes par bzhes la dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor pa skyong ba dang*/ nyams pa can rnams tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing ci ltar bcol ba'i phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod cig /uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa si swā hā/

ces phyi rol du dor/ bshal chu ni shin tu lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ 'dod don smon lam du gsol ba ni/ (425)rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar// byon pa'i bka' brgyud che bzhi chung brgyad kyi// bla ma dam pa byin rlabs drod ldan zhing*// brgyud pa 'chug med byon pa rnams la 'dud// bdag dang slob brgyud bcas pa ma lus la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun stsol zhing*// rang rgyud dul zhing rtogs pa'i gding dang ldan// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thogs med ston nus shog /thos pas phyi yi sgro 'dogs legs chod cing*// bsam pas mdo rgyud dgongs don ji bzhin rtogs// sgom pas gnas lugs sgrib med rjen par mthong*// thos bsam sgom pa mtha' ru phyin par shog /blo gros 'jam pa'i dpal dang dbyer med cing*// snying rje spyan ras gzigs dbang ci 'dra ba// mthu stobs gsang ba'i bdag po ji bzhin du// mkhyen brtse nus pa phul du phyin par shog /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su thag chod de// blo gtad ling bskyur ci mdzad legs mthong zhing*// ci gsung tshad 'dzin thugs yid gcig bsre ba'i// bcos min mos gus phul du phyin par shog /sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang nyid las// blo bur rnam rtog bzang ngan gang skyes pa// gnyug ma nyid kyi ngang du thag chod pa// rnam rtog chos sku kho nar rtogs par shog /phyi nang snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag kun// sems nyid kho na'i mdangs las ma 'das shing*// sems kyang gsal stong spros dang bral ba ste// snang srid phyag rgya chen por 'char bar shog /thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom la sogs// rnam dkar bgyi ba gang dang ci bgyis kun// nga rgyal sdig pa'i grogs su mi 'gyur bar// byang chub mchog gi rgyu ru 'gyur bar shog /bla ma dge (426)'dun bstan pa'i zhabs tog sogs// lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas bsgrub rnams la// do so khas lan drin 'jog mi bsam par// rang don nyid du bltas la sgrub par shog

/bla ma chos lugs grwa sa bzang ngan sogs// rang gi mthong lugs mchog dman gang byung yang*// bzang ngan thams cad kha tshon ma gcod par// kun la dag snang bcos min 'byongs par shog /spyir du 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*// sgos su 'gro ba'i tshe srog rtag min pas// snyom las spangs la long med rgyud bsten nas// nyin mtshan dge sbyor kho nas dus 'da' shog /mi lus tsam po ba yang rnyed dka' na// da des dal 'byor mi lus thob pa 'di// don med stong log yal bar mi 'dor bar// nam bzhag gtan gyi so nam thebs par shog /chos rnams rten 'byung nyid la rag lus phyir// dge 'bras bde thob sdig pa'i 'bras bu yis// sdug bsngal ma lus 'byung bar yid ches te// sdig spang dge sgrub las la spyod par shog /'khor ba'i gnas 'di me 'obs nyid dang mtshungs// ltar snang bde ba'ang sdug bsngal nyid kyi rgyu// thar med dong du chud 'dis ches sngangs te// dgos med nges 'byung rgyud la skye bar shog /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal tsam las thar na yang*// rang nyid kho na zhi bde 'dod pas ni// ma rgan sems can don chen mi 'grub pas// byang chub mchog gi sems mchog skye bar shog /zhi lhag dbyer med don la mnyam bzhag ste// nyams rtogs gong 'phel dbyar gyi chu bo bzhin// rgyun chad med par rtse gcig skyong gyur pas// rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis myur bsgrod shog /nyams rtogs bzang po ji tsam skyes gyur (427)kyang*// blos byas 'dzin pa zhugs na 'chings 'gyur bas// 'dzin med spros bral gsal stong bde ba che// ma bcos phyag rgya chen po myur rtogs shog /spyod lam rnam bzhi'i gang dang gang gi tshe'ang*// yengs med dran pa'i rgyang so dang bcas nas// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod rab brten te// tha mar shes pa'i rang ngo mthong bar shog /na tsha nyon mongs sdug bsngal gang byung yang*// sems kyi cho 'phrul nyid du thag chod pas// spang blang bsal bzhag dgag sgrub kun dor nas// ma spangs rang dag lam du longs par shog

/rang gzhan skye 'gro dpag tu med pa yis// thog ma med nas da lta yan chad du// sdig pa'i bya ba gang dang ci bgyis pa// lan cig rab tu bshags pas kun dag shog /dge rtsa bgyis sam bgyid stsal bgyis pa dang*// rjes su yi rang dge 'bras gang mchis pa// bag la zha dang chud zar mi 'gyur zhing*// rdzogs byang thob pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur bar shog /sbyin sogs phar phyin drug la bslab pa dang*// bla ma sangs rgyas mnyes par byas pa sogs// lus ngag yid kyi dge rtsa gang bsgrubs pa// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyu ru shog /sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma dam pa la// ldog med mos gus drag po rab phul te// bla ma'i ched du lus srog 'bor nus pa'i// theg chen chos kyi go cha bgo bar shog /gang la'ang snying po med par rab shes nas// rnyed bkur grags 'dod kha len ngo srung sogs// zin med tshe 'di'i gdos thag kun bcad nas// 'jig rten chos brgyad dgra 'di myur thul shog /tshogs dang dben pa gang du sdod na yang*// sgo gsum tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar// mi rtag dgos med zhen log nges (428)'byung sogs// chos kyi snying po rgyud la brten par shog /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang*// lha dang drang srong bka' brgyud gong ma sogs// bden tshig 'grub pa'i skyes chen gang dag gis// smon lam gang btab bdag gis 'grub par shog /gnas skabs su yang tshe ring nad med cing*// 'gal rkyen bar cad tshogs rnams rab zhi nas// bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// chos spyod bcu yis rtag tu dus 'da' shog /bdag nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su// char chu dus 'bab lo 'bras rtag tu legs// mi nad phyugs nad 'khrugs rtsod kun zhi ste// bde skyid dpal la rtag tu spyod par shog /bdag gi ming tsam thos par gyur na yang*// rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal rgyun bcad de// mtho ris thar pa'i sgo 'phar rab bye nas// bde chen khang bzang nyams dgar bgrod par shog

/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu sde brgyad dang*// chos skyong srung ma ḍā ki rnams kyis kyang*// bsam sbyor gang mchis de dag thams cad kun// gegs med 'grub pa'i sdong grogs byed par shog /nongs pa bzod gsol ni/ /bdag blo gti mug rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pas// legs byas 'di la nyes par gyur pa gang*// skyes mchog rin chen rnams dang de yi sras// bdag nyid chen po khyod la bzod par gsol/ yig brgya brjod/ de nas lam dbar chu rgyun gcig ma len pa ni/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la smin byed dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// rgyud bzhi myur du smin par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i mdo nyid la// 'khor rnams 'od zhu gtso bo'i (429)sku la thim// gtso bo dkon mchog kun 'dus bdag nyid la// rnam pa bla ma dngos su gsal gyur pa'i// mdzod spu'i gnas nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros// rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob bskyed rim bsgom la dbang*// 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros// rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob rtsa rlung sgom la dbang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// thugs ka'i gnas nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros// rang gi snying gar thim pas yid sgrib dag /sher dbang thob cing snyoms 'jug sgom la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// gnas gsum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros// gnas gsum la thim sgo gsum dri ma dag /bzhi pa'i dbang thob phyag chen sgom par dbang*/ /ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// de nas bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bla ma yi// rdo rje gsum po dbyer med ro gcig cing*// khyer so gsum ldan lhun 'grub rang grol lo/

ces dmigs la bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres te mos gus so ma nyams pa'i rang bab ngang du mnyam par 'jog /de las ldang ba na smon lam ni/ /rtag par theg chen bshes kyi mgon gyur cig /rnyed dang bkur sti rim gro bsgrub pa yi// dkon mchog bla ma'i bka' la nan tan du// gus pa chen pos bstun pa 'phel gyur cig /bla med rdzogs sangs mchog gyi rgyur gyur pa// mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus sgrol pa'i gru// byang chub sems kyi theg pa mi dman pa// zab dang rgya che rtag par gleng gyur cig /byang chub dam pa (430)gang gi spyod pa'i rab// rmad byung sbyin pa la sog pha rol phyin// thog med dus nas rnyed dka'i rin po che// phun tshogs ma lus bde bar 'byor gyur cig /sdig pa'i mun pa 'thug po gar gnas sar// ye shes 'od zer gsal ba'i dpal 'gro ba// ye shes rdo rje rnon po'i btsun mo mchog /shes rab pha rol phyin mas dge gyur cig /theg mchog lam gyi rtse mo rdo rje'i sa// grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi dkyil 'khor che// phyag rgya phyed par dka' ba'i bdud rtsi la// blo bzang dbang pa'i rtogs pa rgyas gyur cig /'chi med rab dga' grub pa'i bde ba na// 'gro kun mtha' gnyis mal nas ldang ba'i sgra// gsang ba rdo rje'i dam chos 'byung ba'i rnga// skal pa mchog gi rna bar brdung gyur cig /ji srid de lta'i dbang phyug ma thob par// bka' brgyud rnams las dwags po bka' brgyud dang*// sgrub rgyud rnams las che bzhi chung brgyad kyi// gdams ngag ma lus rdzogs pa'i snod gyur cig /bkra shis brjod pa ni// zhal nas gsungs pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod sngon du 'gro bas/ /bkra shis kyi dang po bkra shis pa// sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lags// bkra shis de yis bkra shis shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /bkra shis kyi gnyis pa bkra shis pa// dam chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yin// bkra shis de yis bkra shis shog

/bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /bkra shis kyi gsum pa bkra shis pa// zhing mchog dge 'dun mchog rnams yin// bkra shis de yis bkra shis shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa// bka' brgyud ngo mtshar can rnams yin// bkra shis de yis bkra shis shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /gzugs med gzugs kyi khams kyi lha// (431)bsam gtan nang gi dga' bder ldan// de bzhin bdag cag bde skyid shog /bkra shis de yis bkra shis shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /'dod khams 'dod lha rigs drug rnams// 'dod yon sna tshogs rnams kyis rtse// rtag tu dga' dang bde bar ldan// de bzhin bdag cag bde skyid shog /bkra shis de yis bkra shis shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /mi mchog 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// rgyal srid bdun la sogs pa yis// gling bzhir phun sum tshogs pa la// rtag tu bde zhing skyid pa yin// de bzhin bdag cag bde skyid shog /bkra shis de yis bkra shis shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /rten gtso dzam gling rgyan 'dir ni// chos rgyal sku tshe brtan par shog /bstan pa phun sum tshogs par shog /bkra shis kyi rab ma dzam gling rgyan/ dzam gling rgyan gyi bkra shis shog /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /ces brjod cing me tog gi char bab cing rol mo'i sgra snyan la reng bar bsgrag go /rdo rje ye shes bum pa gang byo'i tshul// gcig nas gcig tu bar ma chad pa las// gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'jug nges pa// bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba 'di dag go /yon tan 'byung gnas mchod 'os kun gyi phul// dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i bsod nams kyis// dus gsum rgyal la bsnyen bskur dge 'bras kyang*// zil gyis gnon phyir tshul 'dir 'bad par rigs// legs byas bdud rtsi'i chu gter las 'khrungs pa// yon tan nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor sgrib med kyi// snang bas srid pa gsum du yongs khyab nas// 'gro kun thar pa'i lam bzang la 'jug shog

/ces dad mos 'bad stsol chen pos gces par bsdus pa'i gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las bka' brgyud rin po che'i khrid rim rnams kyis yan lag tu sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa'i gral mtha' 'khod pa ku sā li karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spung yang khrod tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// (432)
